description: This file defines a logging utility class 'Log' for managing and outputting log messages, warnings, errors, and documentation issues with color-coded formatting based on the operating system.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class that handles informational messages, warnings, errors, documentation issues, and supports color-coded output depending on the operating system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Log object with name, verbosity, warning, and documentation issue display options, and setting color codes based on OS.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print messages with optional file prefix.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if show_infos is enabled.

methods.name: DocIssue
methods.description: Logs a documentation issue message if show_doc_issues is enabled.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if show_warnings is enabled.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message associated with a specific line in a file, attempting to extract file and line info from an object.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs a message directly to the console with the log name prefix.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated errors, warnings, and info messages.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Sets the current file context and logs a processing message.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to 32 characters, adding ellipsis at the front or end.
